title: Critical shield sound
description: A resourcepack that replaces the critical hit sound with the shield parry sound.
body: A resource pack that replaces critical hit sounds with shield parry sounds, increasing skill in PvP, and your ears will thank you. I think it's pretty cool. Supported versions are 1.21-1.21.11, recommended versions are 1.21-1.21.1, and the native Minecraft version is 1.21.4
